The Opportunity

Commercial Video Data Collection Partner

This is the official role DJ AI Partnership LLC has applied for. It's reproduced here as posted, so anyone reviewing this page — micro1 included — sees exactly what was applied to.

Role: Contractor Location: Remote Sector: Any business type Requires: 20+ employees

micro1 engages business owners as Video Data Partners to support an egocentric (POV) video data collection initiative used to train next-generation AI systems — including robotics models learning from real manual work.

  1. Facilitate collection of POV video showing manual work processes within the business.
  2. Coordinate high-volume video submissions from participating staff.
  3. Advise on workflows, safety protocols, and operational best practices for data authenticity and compliance.
  4. Communicate project guidelines to contributors for consistent video quality and coverage.
  5. Report on progress, challenges, and process improvements to micro1's project team.
  6. Ensure all data is collected in accordance with privacy, consent, and ethical standards.
  7. Maintain clear written and verbal communication with micro1 to stay aligned on goals.

Non-Negotiable

Consent and privacy come first

micro1's program requires this, and DJ AI Partnership LLC treats it as the foundation of the work — not a checkbox.

Informed, revocable consent

Every person appearing on camera — employees or otherwise — knows they're being recorded and can withdraw at any time.

No bystander footage

No filming of customers, third parties, or private property without explicit, separate consent from those individuals.

No promises until it's real

No pay, spots, or guarantees are offered to anyone until micro1 confirms this partnership in writing.

Questions

Common questions

Is this partnership confirmed with micro1?+
No. The application status is "Form sent to POC" — under review. This page will be updated the moment that changes.
Will I be paid for pre-registering?+
No payment exists at this stage. Pre-registration is free and only expresses interest — it is not a job offer or contract.
What happens to the video data collected?+
Under micro1's program, footage is used to train AI systems. Full terms — retention, usage rights, and compensation — will be shared in writing once the partnership is confirmed.
Do I need to film customers or other people?+
No. Filming is limited to consenting participants performing their own work. Bystanders and customers should not appear without their own separate, explicit consent.
Am I an employee of DJ AI Partnership LLC or micro1?+
No. If confirmed, this is independent contractor work — project-based, no fixed schedule, no employment relationship. Full terms are provided in writing before any work begins.
This page reflects an application in progress with micro1 and is not an offer of employment, guaranteed income, or a confirmed partnership. Terms will be shared in writing if and when micro1 confirms this program.
